start_balance.rule: Available equity (E): the paper account starts with this; every trade is sized from the equity at that moment (no live account is connected).

leverage.rule: Broker leverage 1:3000 (required margin per 1 oz = entry price / 3000).

spread.rule: Transaction cost: baseline USD per oz (spread + commission), charged on entry.

oz_per_lot.rule: Contract size: 1 lot = 100 oz; minimum trade 0.01 lot = 1 oz.

risk_per_trade.rule: Dynamic position sizing: risk = E × this; size (oz) = risk ÷ (1.5 × ATR); lots = max(0.01, floor(size ÷ 100, 0.01)).

max_daily_loss.rule: Max daily loss: once today's loss reaches this share of the day's starting balance (0.10 = 10%), no more trades today; trading resumes tomorrow (local midnight).

ema.rule: Trend condition: SELL only when EMA fast < EMA slow (downtrend); BUY only when EMA fast > EMA slow (uptrend).

breakout_candles.rule: Breakout trigger: SELL when the candle CLOSES below the low of this many previous candles; BUY when it CLOSES above their high (entry at the next candle's open).

rsi.rule: RSI filter: SELL only when RSI is above min_to_sell (no SELL if RSI ≤ 30); BUY only when RSI is below max_to_buy (no BUY if RSI ≥ 70).

atr.rule: Volatility filter: ATR must be at least min_to_spread × spread ($0.78 at baseline).

safety.rule: Max spread safety: no new BUY or SELL while the live spread is above max_spread, or during the daily rollover window (UTC).

stop_atr.rule: Stop loss: SELL = entry price + this × ATR; BUY = entry price − this × ATR.

target_atr.rule: Take profit: SELL = entry price − this × ATR; BUY = entry price + this × ATR.

trail.rule: Trailing stop: once profit reaches start_atr × ATR, the stop follows distance_atr × ATR behind the best price (above the lowest low for a SELL, below the highest high for a BUY) and never moves back.

hold_past_target_while_trend.rule: Trend continuation: if price reaches the initial TP while the trend still points the trade's way (EMA fast below slow for a SELL, above for a BUY), keep the trade open under the trailing stop.

exit_on_trend_flip.rule: Invalidation exit: close at the next candle's open once the EMAs cross against the trade (EMA fast closes above slow for a SELL, below slow for a BUY).

cooldown_candles_after_loss.rule: Cooldown: wait this many completed candles after a losing trade before the next entry.

news.rule: High-impact news and rollover: no entries this many minutes before a high-impact news release for these currencies (Forex Factory calendar), nor during the rollover window above.

auto_tune.rule: Auto-training: after each closed trade and at least every every_minutes, re-test breakout candles (10/20/30), ATR filter (2/3/4× spread), stop (1.5/2 ATR) and take profit (3/4 ATR). Pick the best on the older 70% of the loaded candles; switch only if it also beats the current settings on the newest 30% by at least min_gain USD with min_test_trades trades. Risk, daily loss, spread, rollover, news and cooldown rules are never changed.
